events.description: Spun out from task-profound-code-review-082 §B.4 / §B.5 / §B.6 — three Age 1 unique buildings (Alanthor_Crucible, Runai_VeilsteelFoundry, Feraldis_Foundry) have factories and cost entries but are missing from the BuildableBuildings HashSet, so the player can never construct them.
